'''Grand Admiral Tsung Court of the Vile At-Sts''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Grand Admiral Tsung]]
* '''Published:''' 15 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jabba's Palace: Dungeon|JP-D-jabbaspalacedungeon.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Jabba's Palace: Dungeon
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 Jabba's Palace Dungeon Tsung DS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

At-St's Control the outdoors, Ephant Mon and Jabba the Palace...

== Strategy ==

Much More Strategy from me than usual...

Deploy Prepared Defenses: All Wrapped up, and Inconsiquential Losses.

Deploy Jabba to Audience Chamber From Reserve Deck. If You Can either Profit By this or be Destroyed on table Deploy instead (Ephant Mon and prince Xizor).

Use Vehicles to Control Exterior sites. if interior sites come into play, defend if you can succesfully win the battle, if not Force drain the exterior sites to make them pay.

Ephant Mon should keep Boush away or some Leias. Hutt Smooch could be used to kill Boush if at another site.
